patch_notes.text: The automatic reply-end keep is off by default again, a conversation the server moves aside to make room keeps its whole history, and generation with drafting is back to full speed. The Flash checkpoints are unchanged.
Long answers no longer stop inside a code block, and a request whose client has gone no longer holds up the requests behind it. The Flash checkpoints are unchanged.

Text to speech on the NPU, and a long answer the prompt cache had cut short now gets the room it asked for. Generation is a little faster. The Flash checkpoints are unchanged. At temperature 0 each reply is byte-identical to 0.18.13's, to the same request alone and to serial greedy decode.
